messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy to prod started for tag v1.12.0-rc3 (commit 9b7c2f4). Target: prod/us-east-1. CI gate status: BLOCKED — failing checks. Details: https://ci.redwood.dev/blue/organizations/jenkins/job/1234

elaine: seeing this, thanks. which checks failed?

deploy-bot: CI job 'integration-tests' failed: 3 failed, 12 passed. Failed tests: integration/kvcache_e2e, integration/model_fallback_test, integration/latency_profile. Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/blue/organizations/jenkins/job/1234/runs/9876

samir: can someone paste the failing test logs? quick grep

maria: from logs: setup stage times out connecting to redis, stacktrace shows RedisTimeoutError at setup. looks infra-y, not code change.

kevin: that redis timeout is happening in canary too? Canary was green ~10m ago.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded for v1.12.0-rc3 in staging but prod gate blocked. Canary jobs passed. Prod job env uses redis cluster v2.1 (prod) vs v2.2 (staging) - possible config drift.

oncall: I'm pulling platform metrics now, paging infra.

infra-eng: (infra-eng): Investigating network/connectivity to prod-redis cluster in us-east-1, will update in ~15m.

elaine: options: 1) pin prod to previous tag v1.11.9 and abort RC now to keep release window, 2) force rerun prod CI now after infra fix, 3) rollback canary if we see risk. Thoughts?

samir: prefer rerun after infra fix. If infra takes >30m, pin to v1.11.9 so downstream customers unaffected.

maria: release notes show only model routing weight tweak — no infra changes. Pin is safe if we want to preserve change window.

kevin: +1 pin. I'll open the pin PR and start the abort/pin flow.

deploy-bot: Proposed action: pin prod -> v1.11.9, abort current prod deploy. Creating rollout PR: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/release/pins/342

elaine: go ahead, kevin. coordinate with oncall for rollback steps and add note to release board.

kevin: PR #342 created: prod-pin/v1.11.9. Tagging: 'prod-pin-v1.11.9-2234567890'. Initiating abort.

deploy-bot: Abort initiated for prod deploy (thread 2234567890). Canary unaffected. Notifying release channels.

samir: once infra green we'll rerun full prod CI against RC. If all green, we can reattempt outside of today's change window with release-manager signoff.

oncall: infra fix rolling — prod-redis nodes reporting healthy now, replication lag cleared.

deploy-bot: CI rerun requested: https://ci.redwood.dev/blue/organizations/jenkins/job/1234/runs/9877. Status: queued.

maria: if rerun passes, I'll open a small infra hardening PR to add a short retry on redis bootstrap to reduce transient timeouts.

elaine: sounds good. update the release board and add a short note: hold due to prod redis transient, pinned to v1.11.9.

kevin: release board updated, changelog annotated, pin PR merged.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot: prod deploy aborted and pinned to v1.11.9. Action items: create infra follow-up TICKET-889, rerun CI on RC once infra stable, coordinate hotfix if needed.
